steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files for the HumarLands landing page.

steps.title: Integrate Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN to index.html for modern, utility-first styling.

steps.title: Create Header and Navigation
steps.description: Design a responsive header with the HumarLands logo and navigation links.

steps.title: Develop Hero Section
steps.description: Build the main hero section with a compelling headline, subtitle, and call-to-action button.

steps.title: Implement Mobile Navigation Toggle
steps.description: Add JavaScript logic to handle a mobile hamburger menu for improved responsiveness.

steps.title: Design About Section
steps.description: Create a section to introduce HumarLands, its vision, or key offerings.

steps.title: Add Features/Showcase Section
steps.description: Develop a section to highlight specific features or 'lands' using a responsive grid layout.

steps.title: Create Call to Action (CTA) Section
steps.description: Include an additional call-to-action to encourage user engagement.

steps.title: Build Footer Section
steps.description: Design a footer with copyright information and potentially other useful links.

steps.title: Implement Smooth Scrolling
steps.description: Add JavaScript to enable smooth scrolling to anchor links for better user experience.

steps.title: Refine Responsive Design
steps.description: Ensure all sections are fully responsive and look great on various screen sizes using Tailwind's utility classes.
